# Fixture inbound dependency policy

A fixture for the tests in .github/scripts. Deliberately tiny, and deliberately
free of Markdown links so the repository documentation checker has nothing to
resolve here.

| SPDX identifier | Why it is acceptable inbound |
|---|---|
| `Apache-2.0` | fixture |
| `ISC` | fixture |
| `MIT` | fixture |
